adversarialObservation.environment: Node 24.19.0; direct pinned Aegis scan; performance.now; three runs
adversarialObservation.fixture: 16,384 UTF-8 bytes formed by repeating U+200B followed by x
adversarialObservation.outputObservation: one finding produced a 94,208-byte evidence snippet and a 111,481-byte raw report
adversarialObservation.boundary: CPU and output measurements only; not a browser or mobile timing claim
adversarialObservation.mitigation: v1.0.1 moves evaluation to a dedicated worker, terminates at 30 seconds, and returns input-not-evaluated when published output bounds are exceeded

attestation.mechanism: GitHub Actions OIDC keyless Sigstore signing of the exact receipt bytes and a companion source-binding attestation
attestation.signingPrerequisite: the named repository conformance gate passes in a low-authority prerequisite job and the offline artifact check is repeated before signing the same main revision
attestation.sourceRevisionBinding: the signed companion attestation names GITHUB_SHA, the prerequisite job's matching verified revision, repository, ref, workflow run, exact receipt SHA-256, and the passed prerequisites
attestation.bundleLocation: post-merge workflow artifact containing both signed payloads

claimBoundary.establishes: After the named repository conformance gate passes, agreement among the named source contract, skill bytes, runtime constants, version metadata, and repository checks for that checked-out source revision.
doesNotEstablish: bounded scan duration on every device
production deployment of this source revision
truth of evidence outside the named artifacts
